summary: Routing fixture: a session with only a spec.json and no baseline.json. This simulates the state of a session immediately after plan-creation (or after plan-consolidation) but before any work-implementation has run. The review routing heuristic should dispatch this to plan-review, because there is no executed work to review — only a spec.

behavioral_contract.title: Plan-only session routes to plan-review
behavioral_contract.description: A session with spec.json but no baseline.json should route to plan-review, not work-review.
behavioral_contract.evidence: routing.test.sh asserts the helper returns 'plan-review' for this fixture.
